zh.title: FLYONE Armenia 確定訂購兩架 A321neo　首度直接向 Airbus 購機
zh.summary: FLYONE Armenia 確定向 Airbus 訂購兩架 A321neo，採用 LEAP 發動機與 239 席全經濟艙配置。
body: Airbus 於 9 月 30 日宣布，亞美尼亞航空公司 FLYONE Armenia 已確定訂購兩架 A321neo。這是該公司首次直接向 Airbus 下單。
兩架客機將搭載 CFM International LEAP 發動機，配置 239 席全經濟艙，支援機隊更新與航網擴張。
這項協議先於 2026 年 5 月 5 日以合作備忘錄形式公布。FLYONE Armenia 成立於 2021 年，Airbus 公告指出，其目前營運 11 架 A320 系列客機。

en.title: FLYONE Armenia firms order for two A321neos in first direct Airbus purchase
en.summary: FLYONE Armenia has firmed an order for two A321neos with LEAP engines and 239-seat all-economy cabins.
body: Airbus announced on September 30 that FLYONE Armenia had finalised an order for two A321neos, its first direct aircraft purchase from the manufacturer.
Both aircraft will use CFM International LEAP engines and have 239-seat all-economy cabins to support fleet renewal and network expansion.
The agreement was initially announced as a memorandum of understanding on May 5, 2026. Founded in 2021, FLYONE Armenia currently operates 11 A320 Family aircraft, according to Airbus.
